sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Four phases split by health (100 → 75 → 50 → 25 → 0%). Sabetha stays rooted in place the whole fight, but each phase adds a new turret to manage.

sections.heading: Sabetha's attacks
bullets: Flame Wall: a wall of fire spawns on a random player and rotates around the arena — move with the rotation, don't get boxed in against the edge.
Time Bomb: tags the closest player, explodes in 3s — walk away from the group immediately, and stay clear of a downed ally carrying one.
Flak Shot: hits the furthest player and leaves a burning tar field — don't stand in it.
Below 25%: Platform Crush adds falling debris (dark orange circles) on top of everything else — watch your feet.

sections.heading: Turret phases
bullets: Kernan, then Knuckles, then Karde each spawn as the fight progresses — call kill priority and burn them fast so they don't stack up on the squad.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 9:00 — damage scales up hard past that point. Treat it as a hard wall, not a soft target.
